title: Machi Koro-style round category icon: Soviet car
purpose: Generate the small circular category badge placed immediately before the card title.

integration_context.target_use: Icon asset composited before the title on a blue card.
integration_context.output_preference: RGBA PNG with clean antialiased alpha

parameters.subject: side-profile silhouette of a classic boxy Soviet passenger automobile

pictogram.description: A very simple bold white side-profile silhouette of a recognizable boxy 1970s-1980s Soviet sedan: horizontal hood, squared cabin, short trunk, and two simple circular wheel cutouts. Generic and unbranded.
pictogram.shape_language: chunky geometric slightly rounded solid silhouette

constraints: no text, letters, numbers, logos, emblems, license plate, border, shading, gradient, texture, highlights, shadow, 3D effects, scenery, or card furniture
no transparency holes inside the blue circle except intentionally simple internal negative spaces needed for the car silhouette; outside the circle must be transparent
expected_result: A dark-blue solid circle covering about 85% of a transparent square canvas, with one bold centered white Soviet sedan side-profile pictogram occupying about 54% of the circle.
